items.title: Baker Mayfield: 'Trending' toward sitting Week 11
items.text:
Mayfield (foot) "seems to be trending" toward sitting out Sunday's game against the Lions, with Jalon Daniels likely to draw the Week 11 start, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jalon Daniels: Could be headed for Week 11 start
items.text:
Daniels "seems to be trending" toward drawing the start at quarterback for the Buccaneers on Sunday in Detroit while Baker Mayfield tends to a foot strain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
